connector.name: eBay Browse
connector.registryDescription: eBay Browse API MCP server - buy-side listing search and price intelligence.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ebay-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cunicopia-dev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EBAY_ENV
env.description: Which eBay environment to use: "production" or "sandbox". Defaults to production.

env.name: EBAY_PRD_APP_ID
env.description: eBay production App ID (Client ID) from your eBay developer account. Required for EBAY_ENV=production.

env.name: EBAY_PRD_CERT_ID
env.description: eBay production Cert ID (Client Secret). Required for EBAY_ENV=production.

env.name: EBAY_SBX_APP_ID
env.description: eBay sandbox App ID (Client ID). Required for EBAY_ENV=sandbox.

env.name: EBAY_SBX_CERT_ID
env.description: eBay sandbox Cert ID (Client Secret). Required for EBAY_ENV=sandbox.
